parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

>  You can call the [ListCheckItemWarningSummary](~~ListCheckItemWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason why the check item is added to the whitelist.

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The ID of the whitelist record.

parameters.name: RemoveContainerUuids
parameters.description: A list of asset UUIDs from which container names need to be removed from the whitelist.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. Valid values:

*   **default**: server
*   **agentless**: agentless detection

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the assets on which the whitelist rule takes effect. Valid values:

*   **all_instance**: all servers
*   **instance**: specific servers

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-baseline-check-white-record --lang zh --check-id 16 --record-id 14 --source agentless --target-type all_instance --reason Manually_processed. --remove-container-uuids 0e7aac1c-6536-43d1-9df8-73e2a6500000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpdateBaselineCheckWhiteRecord --region cn-hangzhou --CheckId 16 --RemoveContainerUuids.1 '0e7aac1c-6536-43d1-9df8-73e2a6500000' --TargetType all_instance --Lang zh --RecordId 14 --Source agentless --Reason 'Manually_processed.'
